Name: Fig Tree
Description: The fig is one of the first cultivated trees in Scripture, giving sweet fruit twice a year and broad leaves that once clothed Adam and Eve. Jesus cursed a fruitless fig tree and told a parable of a gardener who pleaded for one more year of patience for a barren tree.
CreationReflection: The fig tree stands for fruitfulness, and for the patience of the Gardener, who tends us one more season rather than cutting us down.
Habitat: Warm, sunny climates around the Mediterranean and Middle East.
